draft: The sun rises over Mexico City, casting a warm glow on skyscrapers and filling streets with activity. Despite authoritarian state, environmental collapse, social conflict, and capitalist hegemony, residents work together to adapt. The government maintains an open-door policy for civic engagement, fostering trust among its people. Community-led initiatives mitigate climate change effects while local co-ops and mutual aid networks temper ongoing social conflicts. Mexico City endures under towering structures and hopeful inhabitants, facing an uncertain future.
